subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**station**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the function of veins within the circulatory system as purifying channels.
 
• The word needed should fit the context of a place or structure where purification happens.
 
• "**Station**" fits well as it can denote a place where specific functions (like purification) are performed.
 
• Other options ("**stage**", "**stand**", "**camp**") do not fit the context of a place associated with purification.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *One of the **most **efficient systems of the human body is the circulatory system. It is considered to be made up of complex and delicate blood vessels which **carry **blood to and from the heart. This system comprises arteries, veins and capillaries. The blood is pushed out of the heart to arteries **under** high pressure. **Therefore**, the arteries have thick and muscular veins. Veins bring blood from all parts of the body and work as the purifying **stations **in the system. Capillaries transfer blood from arteries to veins.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Stage (मंच): "Stage" refers to a point, step, or phase, which does not align with the concept of purification.
 
• Stand (खड़ा करना): "Stand" indicates a place where someone waits or is stationed, but it doesn’t fit well as a purifying structure.
 
• Camp (शिविर): "Camp" refers to a temporary place to stay, which does not match the context of purification channels.
